articles.summary: Camden National Corporation (NASDAQ: CAC) will report financial and operating results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 on Tuesday, July 28, 2026. A conference call and webcast will be held at 3:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, hosted by Simon Griffiths, President and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Archer, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Renée Smyth, Executive Vice President, Chief Experience and Marketing Officer. Parties interested in listening to the teleconference should dial into the call or connect to the webcast link 10 – 15 minutes before it begins.
